items.title: Helen Oakley Dance interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 12, 1998
items.q: I was brought into Mills’ office and that was the other half of my career... I was the producer.

ctx.x: Yes. And that was wonderful. So that really was how I ended up my Chicago thing. But it was Duke who spoke up and said to Irving Mills, “Now then, you’ve got to bring this girl into New York.” Why? Well I’m just telling you. Because that’s how Duke operated. He always spotted, even if you had a minimum amount of talent, he’d find it for you.
